{"id":1847409304,"question_id":3704,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1764919117,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1847409304/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Partitions with Even Sum Difference","memory":"23.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countPartitions(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>pref(n , 0);\n        vector<int>suff(n , 0);\n        int parts = 0;\n\n        pref[0] = nums[0];\n        suff[n-1] = nums[n-1];\n\n        for(int i=1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            pref[i] = pref[i-1] + nums[i];\n        }\n        for(int i = n-2 ; i>=0 ; i--)\n        {\n            suff[i] = suff[i+1] + nums[i];\n        }\n\n        for(int i=1 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            if(abs((pref[i-1] - suff[i]) % 2 == 0)) parts++;\n        }\n        return parts;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-partitions-with-even-sum-difference","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1228}
